svg.title: The adaptive learning loop
svg.desc: A scene receives a learner answer, is handled by one of four key classes, and only certified correctness updates Beta mastery and FSRS memory. Keyword-only feedback and ungraded scenes bypass those updates before routing to the next scene or a due review queue.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', serif

svg.text: Correctness provenance controls what the engine is allowed to learn
